title: Counting calls
prompt: A member `count` starts at 0. Write `tick`, which adds 1 to count. In `solve`, call tick n times using a loop, then return count.
hints: The member keeps its value between calls.

docs.name: var name = value (outside any function)
docs.what: A member variable: every function in the script can read and change it.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: The numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.
